description: This file defines the PlacementFilterStrategyResolver class responsible for resolving placement filter strategies for grain types in Orleans runtime. It manages dependencies, retrieves, and orders filter strategies based on grain properties.

classes.name: PlacementFilterStrategyResolver
classes.description: Resolves and manages placement filter strategies for grain types, ensuring correct ordering and dependency resolution.

methods.name: PlacementFilterStrategyResolver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resolver with service provider and grain properties resolver.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterStrategies
methods.description: Returns the array of placement filter strategies associated with a specific grain type.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterStrategyInternal
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves and orders placement filter strategies based on grain properties and registered services.
